page_title: REI 1-3 MON | Reims v Monaco 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Hakim Ben El Hadj is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Krepin Diatta (Monaco) is given a yellow card.
90+3' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Yehvann Diouf.
90+2' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

90+1' That didn't go as planned! Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Philipp Kohn, who easily kept it out. Reims force a corner. They send men into the box.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Youssouf Fofana will be replaced by Mohamed Camara (Monaco).
86' William Still has decided to make a change. Oumar Diakite (Reims) replaces Teddy Teuma.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Josh Wilson-Esbrand (Reims) is coming onto the pitch as Ibrahim Diakite cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Junya Ito (Reims) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
84' Chrislain Matsima (Monaco) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
83' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
82' A lofted cross from Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
82' We are about to witness a substitution. Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is replacing Folarin Balogun.
79' Teddy Teuma (Reims) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
78' Joseph Okumu (Reims) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Reims force their opponents to concede a corner.
78' The corner by Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

76' A loose ball is pounced on by Takumi Minamino (Monaco) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the top of the net, but Yehvann Diouf is alert and makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. Monaco win a corner kick.
76' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) brings his opponent down. Hakim Ben El Hadj has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mohamed Daramy trots off the pitch and is replaced by Mamadou Diakhon (Reims).
74' A dangerous looking corner kick from Junya Ito (Reims) is cleared to safety by the defence.

74' The ball goes out of play and Reims have been awarded a corner kick. Marshall Munetsi (Reims) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
73' The substitution is prepared. Takumi Minamino (Monaco) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aleksandr Golovin.
70' Thibault De Smet (Reims) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Philipp Kohn intercepts the ball.
68' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
67' CHANCE! Mohamed Daramy (Reims) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a shot towards Philipp Kohn, who produces an excellent reflex save.
66' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle for a foul.
66' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
65' Thibault De Smet (Reims) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Reims will have a throw-in.
64' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

63' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Junya Ito (Reims), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Reims will take a corner.
62' Amine Salama (Reims) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Amine Salama (Reims) comes onto the pitch so that Keito Nakamura can be given a rest.
60' Ibrahim Diakite (Reims) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
57' 1 - 3 Goal! Teddy Teuma (Reims) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Philipp Kohn into the bottom left corner.
57' Teddy Teuma (Reims) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
57' Chrislain Matsima (Monaco) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Reims.
56' Keito Nakamura (Reims) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
55' The foul by Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) was seen by Hakim Ben El Hadj who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
53' Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle as Marshall Munetsi (Reims) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
52' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
51' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Mohamed Daramy (Reims) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
51' Junya Ito (Reims) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
49' 0 - 3 Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) jumps for a cross and plants a precise header low inside the left post.
49' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
48' Junya Ito (Reims) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
48' Junya Ito (Reims) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Reims are awarded a corner kick.
46' 0 - 2 Folarin Balogun (Monaco) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets under the crossbar.
46' Half-time substitution. Adi Hutter decided to make a change. Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) is replaced by Chrislain Matsima.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Junya Ito (Reims) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Philipp Kohn, who smothers the ball.
42' 0 - 1 Goal! Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
38' Monaco are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
35' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
33' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
32' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Monaco win a corner.
30' The resulting corner, taken by Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco), comes to nothing.
30' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner.
30' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Reims comes to nothing.
29' Junya Ito (Reims) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The referee blows his whistle, Reims are awarded a corner kick.
26' Teddy Teuma (Reims) is able to continue to play.
24' Teddy Teuma (Reims) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
24' Monaco can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
24' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Monaco.
23' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
22' Teddy Teuma (Reims) sends the corner into the box, but Philipp Kohn intercepts it and averts the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Reims.
22' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Junya Ito (Reims), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Reims force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
21' Monaco keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
17' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
16' He should have scored! Folarin Balogun (Monaco) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Monaco will take a corner kick.
15' Junya Ito (Reims) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.

15' Thibault De Smet (Reims) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
11' A pass into the box finds Keito Nakamura (Reims) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Philipp Kohn denies him.
8' Reims have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
8' Junya Ito (Reims) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Reims can continue in their attacking effort.
7' Junya Ito (Reims) commits a foul during an attacking move.
6' A corner kick by Reims is thwarted by the well prepared Philipp Kohn (Monaco).

5' Keito Nakamura (Reims) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Reims have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
2' A clumsy foul by Ibrahim Diakite (Reims) and Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle.
2' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but Yehvann Diouf comes off his line to gather the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Reims will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Hakim Ben El Hadj.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
